command: isolated employee run: one approval-gated seren_db_query
claim: An isolated employee invokes the specified database tool and answers from its recorded result.

scope.statement: One isolated employee-mediated table-free query, verified from correlated run/tool/result events and a subsequent stopped read-back. Live execution is blocked pending fixture setup and selective-approval transport.
scope.entry: agent cloud run start/get; selective run resume API
out_of_scope: Broad agent quality or grant auditing

basis.reference: Seren v0.10.0 37654244: CloudDeploymentRunEvent, CloudRunOutputEvent, CloudRunPendingApprovalsResponse, CloudDeploymentRunResumeRequest; cli cloud_run, cloud_run_get, resolve_cloud_run_pending_approvals.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.
Integer arithmetic: 6 multiplied by 7 equals 42. No response-derived expectation or application record needed.

employee_tool.message: Call seren_db_query exactly once with query SELECT 6 * 7 AS answer. Use no other tool and no application tables. After the tool result, reply with exactly 42. Do not answer without executing the tool.

criteria.claim: Completed run belongs to the requested employee and invocation
criteria.evidence: Deployment, returned run ID, execution ID and invocation payload match the captured request.

criteria.claim: Exactly one matching call returns the expected structured result
criteria.evidence: Complete outer event trace: exact tool/arguments, linked call/result ID, result [[42]], successful done.

criteria.claim: Employee answer follows and agrees with tool result
criteria.evidence: Exact final answer 42 after the tool result; model text alone cannot pass.

criteria.claim: Target is confirmed stopped after completion
criteria.evidence: Authoritative target status and desired state stopped; supplied observation timestamp after completion.

employee_tool_result.title: Isolated employee tool workflow lacks the required execution evidence
employee_tool_result.expected: One exact seren_db_query call returns 42, employee answers 42, target confirmed stopped.
employee_tool_result.impact: A correct-looking answer cannot be trusted as evidence of actual tool execution.
unknowns: Current isolated fixture configuration and tool availability
employee_tool_result.retest: Do not run yet: establish isolated fixture setup and selective approval transport, then authorize one bounded execution.

unverified_always.claim: Live execution and isolated fixture setup demonstrated
unverified_always.follow_up: Not yet: offline verifier and selective request builder only; no live driver enabled.
